missing_value_rule: Use null plus unknown_reason when a construct is not observable. Zero means observable absence.

classifications.gambling_ad_present: Promotes wagering, sportsbook, casino, lottery, odds, prediction-market trading, or a gambling-linked offer.
classifications.financial_inducement_present: Offers a bonus, free bet, odds boost, cashback, matched deposit, credit, prize, or similar wagering-linked incentive.
classifications.risk_minimization_claim: Frames wagering or an offer as risk-free, no-sweat, protected, money-back, safe, or otherwise downplays potential loss.
classifications.live_betting_present: Promotes or demonstrates wagering during an event or on rapidly changing in-play markets.
classifications.social_normalization_present: Explicitly presents betting as routine, common, expected, or socially approved.
classifications.fandom_identity_present: Links wagering to team loyalty, supporter identity, or fuller participation in an event.
classifications.celebrity_endorsement_present: A recognizable public figure endorses, recommends, demonstrates, narrates, or normalizes the product.

ratings_0_100.inducement_strength: Magnitude and perceptual prominence of promised value, considering only observable qualifying conditions.
ratings_0_100.win_salience: Degree to which winning, payout, profit, jackpots, or successful users dominate the creative.
ratings_0_100.urgency_scarcity: Strength of immediate-action pressure, countdowns, expiring offers, kickoff deadlines, or live-event timing.
ratings_0_100.betting_actionability: How directly the viewer can translate the ad into a wager using selections, odds, CTA, promo code, QR code, or deep link.
ratings_0_100.perceived_ease: Degree to which betting is depicted as fast, simple, effortless, or one-tap.
ratings_0_100.sensory_salience: Visual contrast, motion, typography, sonic intensity, repetition, and foreground prominence.
ratings_0_100.arousal_excitement: Suspense, celebration, crowd energy, rapid pacing, emphatic voice, music, and emotional intensity.
ratings_0_100.positive_affect: Joy, humor, triumph, anticipation, or pleasure connected to gambling.
ratings_0_100.social_proof_normalization: Degree to which betting is represented as common, socially approved, or integral to ordinary participation.
ratings_0_100.sport_fandom_linkage: Degree to which wagering is fused with team loyalty, fan identity, or event enjoyment.
ratings_0_100.belonging_status_expertise: Association with belonging, status, sophistication, insider knowledge, identity, or skill.
ratings_0_100.responsible_gambling_prominence: Perceptual prominence and comprehensibility of safer-gambling messaging, not mere presence.
ratings_0_100.terms_prominence: Legibility or audibility, duration, contrast, placement, and comprehensibility of material terms.
ratings_0_100.age_restriction_prominence: Perceptual salience of age eligibility or exclusion.

extractions.operator_brand: Exact operator or brand displayed or spoken.
extractions.product_type: sportsbook, exchange, prediction_market, casino, poker, lottery, fantasy, other, none, or unknown.
extractions.sport_event: Named sport, league, team, player, election, event, or market subject.
extractions.offer_type: free_bet, odds_boost, matched_deposit, cashback, bonus_credit, prize, other, none, or unknown.
extractions.headline_amount: Largest promoted monetary or percentage amount exactly as shown.
extractions.minimum_odds: Qualifying minimum odds exactly as shown.
extractions.expiry: Exact expiry, deadline, or event trigger.
extractions.eligibility: New/existing customer, geography, age, payment method, and other conditions.
